$comment: Source of truth for which CHIPS plugins client sites are offered. Client sites read this file from the main branch of danielshields/chips-plugin-manager, so adding a plugin here makes it available everywhere within a few hours. `slug` is the folder the plugin installs into; `main_file` is the primary PHP file inside it, which is NOT always named after the repo.

plugins.name: CHIPS Plugin Manager
plugins.description: Installs and updates CHIPS utility plugins directly from their public GitHub repositories.
plugins.author: CHIPS

plugins.name: CHIPS – Text Input with Format
plugins.description: Adds a custom ACF field type (Floating RTE) with a minimal rich-text editor that shows a small tooltip on text selection (bold, italic, link, clear).
plugins.author: CHIPS

plugins.name: CHIPS WP Overrides
plugins.description: Overriding the same things on every WP site (comments, Howdy, avatars, etc).
plugins.author: Dan Shields

plugins.name: CHIPS Duplicator
plugins.description: Adds a “Duplicate” row action in wp-admin lists to clone posts/pages/custom post types into a new draft (including ACF/meta and taxonomies).
plugins.author: CHIPS

plugins.name: CHIPS SMTP Configuration
plugins.description: Routes wp_mail through authenticated SMTP. Reads credentials from wp-config constants or environment variables first, falling back to a settings page with a test-send.
plugins.author: CHIPS
